_about: Public-domain William Turnbull Leach (1805-1886), minister of St Andrew's Church, Toronto, who left the Church of Scotland for the Church of England and served in Montreal as canon and professor at McGill, for the Word Hoard: his Toronto sermons and discourses (1837-1841), an address on Rechabitism, a Mercantile Library lecture, his Montreal discourses for Christmas and St George's Day, an Advent sermon, and A Great Work Left Undone. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 111 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wtleach-sermon-1837: A sermon, preached in St. Andrew's Church, Toronto, on the thirtieth day of November, 1837 (St. Andrew's Day) ([Toronto? : s.n.], 1838)
wtleach-military: Discourse on the nature and duties of the military profession : delivered in Saint Andrew's Church, Toronto, to the 93d Highlanders, on the eve of their departure from Toronto garrison (Toronto : H. Scobie, 1840)
wtleach-freemasons: A discourse, delivered to St. Andrew's Lodge (No. 1,) of Freemasons, on Monday, the 28th December, 5840 [i.e. 1840] : being the annual festival of St. John the Evangelist (Toronto : Printed by order of the Lodge, by H. Scobie, 1841)
wtleach-rechabitism: An address on rechabitism : delivered at the quarterly meeting of the members of the Independant Order of Rechabites, in the hall of the Spring of Canada Tent on the 18th July, 1845 ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1845)
wtleach-mercantile: Introductory lecture for the Mercantile Library Association delivered on the 9th January 1854 ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1854)
wtleach-christmas-1861: Discourse delivered in St. George's Chapel, Montreal, on Christmas day, 1861 : (the 6th and 7th companies of the Prince of Wales Regiment being present) ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1862)
wtleach-st-george-1862: A discourse delivered in Christ Church Cathedral on St. George's Day, 23rd April, 1862 : before the St. George's Society of Montreal by the Rev. Canon Leach, D.C.L. and published at the request of the society ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1862)
wtleach-great-work: A great work left undone, or, The desideratum in systems of education : a lecture delivered on the 26th January, 1864 ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1864)
wtleach-advent-1851: Sermon preached in St. George's Chapel, Montreal, on Advent Sunday, 1851 : appointed by authority, for the celebration of the third semi-centennial jubilee of the Society for the Propagation of the Gospel in Foreign Parts ([Montéal? : s.n.], 1993)
